family.tagline: A lake house where the grandchildren's photos stay put.
family.story: Anders is a semi-retired civil engineer who still keeps two clients. Chiamaka is a ceramicist who sells her pots at craft fairs. Their lake house fills with grandchildren every holiday.

companion.name: Ruben
companion.job: Drafts consulting updates and meeting notes from what Anders texts it.
companion.limits: Drafts only. Anders reads and sends every note.

companion.name: Ife
companion.job: Opens Nextcloud in its own browser and files kiln logs and glaze notes.
companion.limits: One page at a time. Chiamaka checks each result.

popup.title: A parcel at the door
popup.body: A parcel waits at the top of the stair, a week before the cousins arrive. Anders carries it through the entry passage to a living room shelf Chiamaka cleared.

popup.title: Unbox the Companion Core
popup.body: Chiamaka lifts out the Companion Core, a power cable, a quick-start guide and a recovery USB drive. The Core's footprint is about three quarters of a sheet of paper.

popup.title: Plug it in
popup.body: Chiamaka plugs in the cable and presses the button. The Core wakes and opens its own Wi-Fi network.

popup.title: Join it from a phone
popup.body: Anders joins the Core's own network from his phone. Then he chooses the lake house network and types its password.

popup.title: Pick your first agents and apps
popup.body: In Companion Hub, Chiamaka picks OpenClaw and Anders picks Hermes. They add Immich, Nextcloud and Companion Memory (beta). Then they walk away.

beats.capability: talks to you through the messaging platform you pick

popup.title: Ruben says hello
popup.body: Anders texts the agent he named Ruben. Ruben answers, and the Core is running.
popup.note: Messages pass through the chat service you choose.

say.speaker: anders
say.text: Good evening, Anders. I am Ruben.

beats.capability: back up, search and organise your family photos and videos on your own Core

popup.title: The cousins' photos, on one shelf
popup.body: Four phones, one shelf. The cousins' photos go into one Immich library on the Core, and Chiamaka sorts them from the couch.

beats.capability: stream your own movies, shows and music to every screen in the house

popup.title: Film night from the family collection
popup.body: On Friday night Anders plays an old film from his own collection. Jellyfin streams it from the Core to the living-room TV while the cousins argue over popcorn.

beats.capability: send files between phones and laptops on the same Wi-Fi

popup.title: A clip crosses the room
popup.body: Tobi sends a clip from the dock to his grandfather's laptop with PairDrop. Both are on the lake house Wi-Fi, so the file goes straight across.

beats.capability: control and automate your smart home from one place, locally

popup.title: Lights that dim at dusk
popup.body: At dusk the living room lights dim on a schedule Anders set in Home Assistant. It runs on the Core and reaches the lights over the home Wi-Fi.

beats.capability: a shared grocery list, recipe book, meal planner

popup.title: A dinner list for every phone
popup.body: Chiamaka plans the holiday dinner in KitchenOwl at the breakfast bar. Anders adds the fish, Linnea adds the cinnamon, and the list updates on every phone.

beats.capability: track every subscription you pay for and get a reminder before it renews

popup.title: Every renewal, announced in advance
popup.body: Anders lists the household's subscriptions in Wallos at the counter. A reminder arrives before each one renews, so he decides what stays.

beats.capability: a whiteboard with a hand-drawn look. Sketch ideas together

popup.title: A dock plan, drawn together
popup.body: Tobi wants a new dock. Anders, a civil engineer, sketches the posts while Tobi draws the boat, both in Excalidraw at the dining table.

beats.capability: track time per project and client, with reports

popup.title: Two clients, hours kept straight
popup.body: Two clients, two projects. Anders logs his hours in Kimai at the green room desk. The report is ready when he sends the invoice.

beats.capability: talks to you through the messaging platform you pick

popup.title: A client update, drafted
popup.body: Anders texts Ruben his site notes. Ruben drafts the client update. Anders reads it, fixes it and sends it himself.

say.speaker: anders
say.text: Your draft is ready. Please read it first.

beats.capability: merge, split, compress and convert PDFs on your own Core

popup.title: Drawings and letter, one PDF
popup.body: Anders merges three drawings and a cover letter into one PDF with Stirling-PDF. The merge runs on the Core, and he sends the file to the client.

beats.capability: your files, calendar and contacts on your own Core, synced to your devices

popup.title: Ife files the kiln log
popup.body: At the end of a firing, Chiamaka hands Ife the kiln log. Ife opens Nextcloud in its own browser and files the glaze notes. Chiamaka checks the folder.

beats.capability: a spreadsheet-database stored as a SQLite file you can copy

popup.title: Every pot gets a row
popup.body: Before the autumn fair, Chiamaka lists every pot in a Grist table: glaze, size and price. The table is a single file on the Core.

beats.capability: design and prototype in a web-based design tool you host

popup.title: Price cards, designed at home
popup.body: Chiamaka designs the price cards for her fair table in Penpot, a design tool hosted on the Core. She prints a set before each fair.

beats.capability: keeps your digital life on your own disk

popup.title: Chiamaka decides what Memory reads
popup.body: Chiamaka chooses which folders Companion Memory may read. Ife uses only those notes, and she can disconnect them whenever she likes.

beats.capability: stream your own music collection to any device

popup.title: Grandpa's albums, found and played
popup.body: Tobi finds his grandfather's old albums in Navidrome and plays them beside the record player. The music streams from the Core to his phone.

beats.capability: listen to your audiobooks and podcasts, and pick up where you left off on any device

popup.title: Linnea keeps her place
popup.body: Linnea listens to a bedtime audiobook in the loft. Audiobookshelf keeps her place for tomorrow night.

beats.capability: track your plants, watering and care history across rooms and beds, with photos and a garden journal

popup.title: Planters with a care journal
popup.body: Chiamaka logs the stepped planters in HortusFox: where each herb grows and when she watered it.

beats.capability: a local video recorder with object detection for your IP cameras

popup.title: The stair camera records at home
popup.body: An IP camera at the foot of the stair streams to Frigate. The video stays on the Core, and Anders plays the clips on the home network.

popup.title: One shelf for the whole family
popup.body: Photos, drawings, glaze notes and a dock plan. The Lindqvist-Abara household keeps it all on one Companion Core in the living room.

closing.body: Your family's photos, files and agents can live on a Companion Core at home. Start with one shelf, and let the cousins fill it.

notes: Owner sign-off open: the FTUE hotspot flow is written as the owner specified and is not on the fact sheet (STORY-BIBLE section 15, item 1).
terrace-camera assumes the family owns an IP camera. Cameras are not in the parcel and not in the 3D scene.
Ife has Companion Memory (beta) connected, opt-in; studio-memory shows the choice. The first mention is in ftue-pick.
Cousins Tobi (13) and Linnea (9) are visitors: third person only, no companion, never voiced.
Town Tamsin Reach and street Heron Rise are invented; still needs the human map check.
